context_witness_policy: Agent-reviewed, pre-registered source facts; not human Gold, not exhaustive ordinal labels, not model inputs. Only named-scope witnesses can supply the extra fourth point after a grounded direct operation. Lack of a witness never lowers an operational 3 below relevance threshold. Shared witnesses introduce common annotation bias; report this limitation.

grade_rules.0: No operational link; generic effort/time/industry alone is insufficient
grade_rules.2: Grounded partial or supporting operation; no direct complete A/O/O match
grade_rules.3: Actual source-backed operation plus AI-judged functional equivalence of action/object/output and compatible operation family
grade_rules.4: 3 plus distinct additional target core operation with distinct source evidence, or a pre-verified scope-specific problem-condition witness

silver_policy: No majority approval. Keep three judge-specific scores and unanimous/disputed flags. Release search evaluation only after complete sources and disagreement review; publish per-judge results and uncertainty bounds, never treat disputed consensus as irrelevant.
